plugins.name: adcopilot-meta-ads
plugins.description: Reads and audits your Meta ad accounts, finds wasted spend, reports results, and builds campaigns, ad sets and ads (always paused), audiences, custom conversions and rules (created off) on your yes. Also checks the Meta Pixel in Google Tag Manager and Facebook and Instagram traffic in Google Analytics. Every change is proposed first.
